evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet coin selection and coin fetching in src/wallet/spend.cpp and wallet RPCs.
rationale: Prevents cryptic RPC failures caused by unhandled internal exceptions during transaction construction. When spending unconfirmed UTXOs exceeding MiniMiner's 500-transaction cluster limit, transaction creation previously threw an uncaught 'map::at' exception (issue #29711); this replaces that failure with an explicit, descriptive user-facing error.
